data.name: Jabr
data.gender_notes: Jabr is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘J-B-R’ which means ‘to press, to compel, to be firm, or to be determined.’ In Islamic context, Jabr is considered as a divine decree, the will of Allah, which cannot be changed by human intervention. The name Jabr carries the meaning “Firmness, Compulsion, Determination” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jabr usually hope their child will grow to embody firmness, compulsion, determination and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the divine will and the importance of submission to Allah.
data.etymology: Jabr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firmness, Compulsion, Determination.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jabr total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: جبر
in_arabic.meaning: جبر يعني القوة والقدرة على التغلب على الظلم
in_arabic.long_meaning: جبر هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ج-ب-ر' والذي يعني القوة والقدرة على التغلب على الظلم أو الفقر. في القرآن الكريم، يأتي الجبر بمعنى الإصلاح والتعويض. كما ورد في الحديث النبوي، جبر هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني جبر القلوب وإصلاحها.

in_urdu.name: جبر
in_urdu.meaning: جبر کا مطلب ہے طاقت اور ظلم پر فتح حاصل کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: جبر ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ج-ب-ر' کے جڑ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے طاقت اور ظلم یا غریبوں پر فتح حاصل کرنا۔ اسلامی روایات میں، جبر کو اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک کے طور پر ذکر کیا گیا ہے، جو دل کو سکون اور اصلاح دینے کے معنی میں ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जबर
in_hindi.meaning: जबर का अर्थ है शक्ति और अन्याय पर विजय
in_hindi.long_meaning: जबर एक अरबी नाम है जो 'ज-ब-र' मूल से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति और अन्याय या गरीबी पर विजय। इस्लामी परंपरा में, जबर को अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक के रूप में उद्धृत किया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है हृदय को शांति और सुधार प्रदान करना।

in_pashto.name: جبر
in_pashto.meaning: جبر معنی یې قوت او د ظلم پر مغلوبیت
in_pashto.long_meaning: جبر د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چي د 'ج-ب-ر' په ريښې د قوت او د ظلم يا فقر پر مغلوبیت معنی ورکوي. په قرآن کې، جبر د اصلاح او تاوان د ورکړې معنی لري. په نبوي حديث کې، جبر د الله ښو نومونو څخه يو دی، چي د زړونو د اصلاح او جبر معنی لري.

in_english.name: Jabr
in_english.meaning: Jabr means strength, power, and overcoming injustice
in_english.long_meaning: Jabr is an Arabic name derived from the root 'j-b-r', signifying strength, power, and the ability to overcome injustice or poverty. In the Quran, Jabr connotes the meaning of reform and compensation. The name is also associated with one of the beautiful names of Allah, indicating the repair and rectification of hearts.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل (جبر)

data.cultural_impact: The concept of Jabr, also known as Decree or Predestination, is universally acknowledged in Islamic theology and is deeply rooted in the Islamic cultural psyche. The belief in Jabr influences various aspects of lives of Muslims, including their worldview, determination, and behavior. Islamic law recognizes the existence of Jabr by prohibiting Muslims from questioning the will of Allah and admonishing those who insist on destiny being entirely contingent on human actions. Moreover, the belief in Jabr plays a significant role in building trust in a person's faith and submission to Allah, allowing Muslims to release concerns over the future and embrace the present moment.
data.spiritual_significance: Jabr is a crucial doctrine in Islamic spirituality that underlines the absolute supremacy of God's will over human desires. The belief in Jabr allows Muslims to surrender themselves fully to God and embrace the notion that everything that occurs is part of His divine plan. This principle seeks to promote a sense of trust, humility, patience, and gratitude among Muslims, as it encourages them to recognize that their lives are in Allah's hands and that their ultimate reward or punishment lies with Him. In short, the understanding of Jabr is an essential aspect of Islam that strengthens a believer's faith, fosters passive obedience, and ultimately, instills a profound sense of reliance on the benevolence and wisdom of Allah.
